description: This file declares functions, classes, and methods related to convolution operations using XNNPACK within the PyTorch codebase. It includes creation, running, and unpacking prepacked convolution contexts for 2D convolutions, as well as the main convolution function.

classes.name: ContextConv2D
classes.description: A context object encapsulating the parameters for a 2D convolution operation, used to facilitate optimized execution.

methods.name: createConv2dClampPrePackOpContext
methods.description: Creates a pre-packed context for a 2D convolution with optional clamping, given the convolution parameters.

methods.name: createConv2dTransposeClampPrePackOpContext
methods.description: Creates a pre-packed context for a transposed 2D convolution with optional clamping.

methods.name: conv2d_clamp_run
methods.description: Executes a 2D convolution with clamp parameters using the provided operation context.

methods.name: unpack_prepacked_sizes_conv2d
methods.description: Unpacks the sizes of a pre-packed convolution from an IValue.

methods.name: conv2d_transpose_clamp_run
methods.description: Executes a transposed 2D convolution with clamp parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a ContextConv2D object with provided convolution parameters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs convolution operation using the given ContextConv2D.

methods.name: convolution2d
methods.description: Main function to perform 2D convolution given input, weight, bias, and convolution parameters.
